ad_library.summary: Arkahub - the consumer brand of Interglacial Renewable Technologies Pvt. Ltd., listed on the MNRE portal under that name and backed by Kae Capital, Antler and Sparrow after a $2 million seed round - runs two Telugu ads into the Hyderabad market (14 and 15 Oct 2026). The second points at a dedicated Hyderabad landing page (arkahub.in/hyderabad). The site claims 900+ happy customers, monthly panel health checks and cleaning for 4 years, 12-year panel / 25-year performance / 10-year inverter warranties, and lists Hyderabad among its operational cities alongside Bengaluru, Pune and Nagpur. Its registered office is in Bengaluru (Marthahalli).

funnel.meaning: Both live ads point at pages on arkahub.in - one generic design page, one Hyderabad-specific page. The paid path lands on owned ground, which is the right structure; the gap is that the ads speak Telugu while the destination pages and the consultation form are English-first.

findings: Two live Telugu ads (14 and 15 Oct) and both point at owned pages - the second at a dedicated Hyderabad landing page (arkahub.in/hyderabad). The paid path already lands on owned ground.

The two ads test two genuinely different angles - aesthetics (hidden wires, flush-mount custom GI structure, 'solar that doesn't spoil the look of your home') versus trust paperwork (price, 30-year warranty and 5 years free maintenance in writing). A real creative test.
Language mismatch: both ads are Telugu, while arkahub.in's homepage, city selector and consultation form are English-first - the click lands in a different language from the one that earned it.

Trust assets that never appear in the ad copy: MNRE-portal listing as Interglacial Renewable Technologies Pvt. Ltd., institutional backing (Kae Capital, Antler, Sparrow; $2M seed) and the 900+ customers claim.
Hyderabad is one of four operational cities (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Nagpur) with a registered office in Bengaluru - the Hyderabad page is doing the work of a local presence.
next_steps: Mirror the ad language on the landing page
Both ads are Telugu; arkahub.in/hyderabad and the consultation form are English-first. A Telugu headline and form labels on the Hyderabad page keep the click in the language that earned it.
Put the paperwork promise on the Hyderabad page
The winning ad angle is 'price, warranty and maintenance in writing' - the Hyderabad page should carry exactly that, plus the MNRE listing and the institutional backing.
Hyderabad is one of four cities on the site - a Hyderabad team page, local install photos and a local number turn a city page into a local promise.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
